arguments.message:
Sure! To re‑enrol two‑factor authentication:
1. Open **Settings → Security → Two‑factor authentication**.
2. Choose **Reset**.
3. Scan the new QR code with your authenticator app and enter the fresh six‑digit code to confirm.
4. Save the new recovery codes that appear.

If you can’t reach the settings page because you don’t have a working code, you can sign in with a saved recovery code and reset from there. Note that re‑enrolling invalidates the old QR code – only the newly scanned one will work after the reset.
